name: nda-handshake
description: Put a standard mutual NDA in place with another company by a sealed exchange of three emails.
long_description: NDA Handshake lets two companies' assistants settle a standard mutual NDA without trading redlines. Each company keeps a small file with its details and its NDA positions. The assistants exchange three emails under seal, so neither side sees the other's positions before fixing its own, and both work out the same NDA. Everything runs on your own computer. Nothing is fetched from the network, nothing is sent without you, and nothing is signed for you.

tools.name: handshake
tools.description: The front door: starts a handshake, or works out and runs the next step of a sealed exchange from an email.

tools.name: draft_nda
tools.description: Makes an ordinary draft NDA, on the standard form with the company's preferred positions, for a counterparty that does not use NDA Handshake.

tools.name: setup
tools.description: Chooses the folder for the company's own file and completed NDAs.

tools.name: draft_file
tools.description: Writes the company's own nda-handshake.md from its facts and NDA positions.

tools.name: check_file
tools.description: Checks one nda-handshake.md and reports anything missing or not allowed.

tools.name: fingerprint
tools.description: Returns the fingerprint of an nda-handshake.md.

tools.name: match
tools.description: Matches two nda-handshake.md files and returns the agreed terms or the conflicts.

tools.name: make_document
tools.description: Writes the signable Mutual NDA as a Word document for an agreed result.

storage_folder.title: Storage folder
storage_folder.description: Where to keep your company's NDA Handshake file and your completed NDAs.
